brief: Our chain of physical-therapy centres wants clients to reserve visits through the internet and get automatic text-message nudges beforehand, plus a prepayment for the first appointment. Front desk staff need a daily agenda view.

We operate lorries across the country with location devices from several suppliers. Dispatchers juggle three different websites. We want everything on one screen with notifications when a lorry idles too long or strays off its planned path.

Purchasing at our home-improvement stores relies on experience and spreadsheets. We want software that predicts how many units of each item will sell next week in each region and recommends how much to order, while letting the purchasers adjust.

Employees who walk the aisles collecting goods for customer shipments make too many mistakes. We would like a handheld application that tells them where to go next and confirms each article by scanning it, even when the wireless network drops.

Unplanned stoppages of our moulding equipment are costing us money. Equipment comes from many manufacturers and is decades old. We want to stream readings from the machines into a central place, see live status and receive early warnings so repairs are scheduled.

Years of agreements are stored as scanned documents and text files across network folders. Staff cannot find earlier wording for similar provisions. We want a search that understands meaning, restricts visibility per engagement, and keeps everything inside our cloud tenancy.

Our group of private schools has pupil records in one product and marks in another, and staff retype names twice. We need the two to stay aligned automatically each night, with alerts to guardians when a child is missing.

A residential sales company wants a public website where buyers search homes on a map, save their searches and get alerts, while its negotiators upload photos and details of houses. Enquiries should reach the right negotiator.

A health plan wants members to talk to doctors by webcam from their browser, with the doctors writing digital prescriptions into the member profile. Sign-in must use the insurer's existing single sign-on.

A chain of cafes wants a phone application that gives customers points for purchases, lets them redeem free drinks and sends promotional messages. Cash registers are ancient and cannot connect, and shop internet is patchy.
